title.en: Between the village and the city

intro.en: A young husband and wife talk about leaving the village and moving to the capital because of his new job. Listen for the reasons each of them gives.
intro.ur: Ek jawan miyan biwi gaon chhod kar daarul-hukoomat jaane ke baare mein baat karte hain kyunke shauhar ko wahan nayi naukri mili hai. Sunein ke dono kya wajah batate hain.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ زَوْجانِ شابّانِ عَنْ تَرْكِ القَرْيَةِ وَالسَّكَنِ في العاصِمَةِ بِسَبَبِ عَمَلٍ جَديدٍ لِلزَّوْجِ. اِسْتَمِعْ إِلَى الأَسْبابِ الَّتي يَذْكُرُها كُلٌّ مِنْهُما.

dialogue.ar: وَصَلَتْني رِسالَةٌ مِنَ الشَّرِكَةِ يا مَرْيَمُ، يُريدونَني أَنْ أَعْمَلَ في العاصِمَةِ.
dialogue.tr: waṣalatnī risālatun mina sh-sharikati yā maryamu, yurīdūnanī an aʿmala fī l-ʿāṣimati.
dialogue.en: A message came to me from the company, Maryam; they want me to work in the capital.
dialogue.ur: Maryam, mujhe company ka paighaam aaya hai, woh chahte hain ke main daarul-hukoomat mein kaam karun.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ نَتْرُكُ القَرْيَةَ الَّتي وُلِدْنا فيها؟
dialogue.tr: wahal natruku l-qaryata llatī wulidnā fīhā?
dialogue.en: And shall we leave the village in which we were born?
dialogue.ur: Kya hum us gaon ko chhod denge jahan hum paida hue?

dialogue.ar: الشَّرِكَةُ هُناكَ كَبيرَةٌ، وَالجامِعَةُ قَريبَةٌ مِنْها، فَتُكْمِلينَ دِراسَتَكِ.
dialogue.tr: ash-sharikatu hunāka kabīratun, wal-jāmiʿatu qarībatun minhā, fatukmilīna dirāsataki.
dialogue.en: The company there is big and the university is near it, so you can complete your studies.
dialogue.ur: Wahan ki company bari hai aur jamia uske qareeb hai, to aap apni parhai mukammal kar sakengi.

dialogue.ar: وَمَزْرَعَةُ أَبيكَ؟ مَنْ سَيَهْتَمُّ بِالأَشْجارِ وَالحَيَواناتِ؟
dialogue.tr: wamazraʿatu abīka? man sayahtammu bil-'ashjāri wal-ḥayawnāti?
dialogue.en: And your father's farm? Who will take care of the trees and animals?
dialogue.ur: Aur aapke abbu ka khet? Darakhton aur janwaron ka khayal kaun rakhega?

dialogue.ar: أَخي الصَّغيرُ سَيَبْقى مَعَ أَبي، وَسَنَزورُهُمْ كُلَّ أُسْبوعٍ.
dialogue.tr: akhī ṣ-ṣaghīru sayabqā maʿa abī, wasanazūruhum kulla usbūʿin.
dialogue.en: My little brother will stay with my father, and we will visit them every week.
dialogue.ur: Mera chhota bhai abbu ke saath rahega aur hum har hafte unse milne aayenge.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَخافُ مِنَ العاصِمَةِ، فَالحَوادِثُ فيها كَثيرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: anā akhāfu mina l-ʿāṣimati, fal-ḥawdithu fīhā kathīratun.
dialogue.en: I am afraid of the capital, for accidents there are many.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe daarul-hukoomat se dar lagta hai kyunke wahan haadsaat bohat hote hain.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا لا أُحِبُّ التَّلَوُّثَ وَالضَّوْضاءَ وَالازْدِحامَ هُناكَ، لَكِنَّ العَمَلَ مُهِمٌّ لَنا.
dialogue.tr: wa'anā lā uḥibbu t-talawwutha waḍ-ḍawḍā'a wal-zdiḥāma hunāka, lakinna l-ʿamala muhimmun lanā.
dialogue.en: And I do not like the pollution, noise and crowding there, but the work is important for us.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe bhi wahan ki aaloodgi, shor aur bheed pasand nahi, lekin yeh kaam hamare liye ahem hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمَنْ سَيَكونُ جيرانَنا هُناكَ؟ أَهْلُنا هُنا يُحِبّونَنا.
dialogue.tr: waman sayakūnu jīrānanā hunāka? ahlunā hunā yuḥibbūnanā.
dialogue.en: And who will our neighbours be there? Our family here loves us.
dialogue.ur: Aur wahan humare padosi kaun honge? Yahan humare ghar wale hum se mohabbat karte hain.

dialogue.ar: سَيَبْقى أَهْلُنا في قُلوبِنا، وَسَنَتَّصِلُ بِهِمْ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
dialogue.tr: sayabqā ahlunā fī qulūbinā, wasanattaṣilu bihim kulla yawmin.
dialogue.en: Our family will stay in our hearts, and we will call them every day.
dialogue.ur: Humare ghar wale humare dilon mein rahenge aur hum rozana unse raabta karenge.

dialogue.ar: فِكْرَةٌ مَعْقولَةٌ. هَلْ نَبيعُ بَيْتَنا القَديمَ وَنَسْكُنُ هُناكَ؟
dialogue.tr: fikratun maʿqūlatun. hal nabīʿu baytanā l-qadīma wanaskunu hunāka?
dialogue.en: A reasonable idea. Shall we sell our old house and live there?
dialogue.ur: Munasib khayal hai. Kya hum apna purana ghar bech kar wahan rahenge?

dialogue.ar: نَبيعُهُ، وَنَشْتَري شَقَّةً صَغيرَةً قُرْبَ الشَّرِكَةِ.
dialogue.tr: nabīʿuhu, wanashtarī shaqqatan ṣaghīratan qurba sh-sharikati.
dialogue.en: We sell it and buy a small flat near the company.
dialogue.ur: Hum use bechte hain aur company ke qareeb ek chhota flat khareedte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَمَتى نَرْحَلُ؟
dialogue.tr: wamatā narḥalu?
dialogue.en: And when do we leave?
dialogue.ur: Aur hum kab rawana honge?

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ شَهْرٍ إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ. أَشْكُرُكِ عَلى صَبْرِكِ يا مَرْيَمُ.
dialogue.tr: baʿda shahrin in shā'a llāh. ashkuruki ʿalā ṣabriki yā maryamu.
dialogue.en: After a month, God willing. I thank you for your patience, Maryam.
dialogue.ur: Ek mahine baad, inshaAllah. Maryam, aapke sabr ka shukriya.

q.en: Why do Tariq and Maryam think of moving to the capital?
q.ur: Tariq aur Maryam daarul-hukoomat jaane ka kyun sochte hain?
q.ar: لِماذا يُفَكِّرُ طارِقٌ وَمَرْيَمُ في الانْتِقالِ إِلَى العاصِمَةِ؟

options: Tariq has a new job there

q.en: What does Maryam fear in the capital?
q.ur: Maryam ko daarul-hukoomat mein kis cheez ka dar hai?

q.en: Which problems of the capital does Tariq mention?
q.ur: Tariq daarul-hukoomat ke kaun se masle batata hai?
q.ar: أَيَّ مَشاكِلَ في العاصِمَةِ يَذْكُرُ طارِقٌ؟

q.en: What do they decide in the end?
q.ur: Aakhir mein woh kya faisla karte hain?

options: Sell the old house and buy a flat near the company
options_ar: أَنْ يَبيعا البَيْتَ القَديمَ وَيَشْتَرِيا شَقَّةً قُرْبَ الشَّرِكَةِ

intro.en: Two sounds look alike: a long ee (ـِي, like in بِيع) and a soft ay (ـَيْ, like in بَيْع). Listen and notice the difference, then read the pairs.
intro.ur: Do awaazein milti julti hain: lambi "ee" (ـِي jaise بِيع) aur narm "ay" (ـَيْ jaise بَيْع). Suniye aur farq dekhiye, phir jodiyan parhein.
intro.ar: صَوْتانِ يَتَشابَهانِ: ياءُ المَدِّ (ـِي) مِثْلَ «بِيع»، وَياءُ اللِّينِ (ـَيْ) مِثْلَ «بَيْع». اِسْتَمِعْ وَلاحِظِ الفَرْقَ، ثُمَّ اقْرَأِ الأَزْواجَ.

q.en: Which word has a long ee sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein lambi "ee" ki awaaz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها ياءُ مَدٍّ (صَوْتٌ طَويلٌ)؟

q.en: Which word has the soft ay sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein narm "ay" ki awaaz hai?

q.en: How is the soft yaa written?
q.ur: Narm yaa kaise likha jata hai?

q.en: Which pair shows the two sounds?
q.ur: Kaunsi jodi mein dono awaazein hain?

intro.en: The joining letters are و (and), ف (then, straight after), ثُمَّ (then, later) and أَوْ (or). The word after the letter follows the same ending as the word before it.
intro.ur: Huroof-e-atf yeh hain: و (aur), ف (phir, foran), ثُمَّ (phir, kuch der baad) aur أَوْ (ya). Harf ke baad wale lafz ka iraab pehle wale jaisa hota hai.
intro.ar: حُروفُ العَطْفِ هِيَ: و، ف (بَعْدَ مُباشَرَةٍ)، ثُمَّ (بَعْدَ مُهْلَةٍ)، أَوْ. وَتَتْبَعُ الكَلِمَةُ بَعْدَها إِعْرابَ الكَلِمَةِ الَّتي قَبْلَها.

dialogue.ar: في المَدينَةِ مَصانِعُ وَأَسْواقٌ وَجامِعاتٌ.
dialogue.tr: fī l-madīnati maṣāniʿu wa'asawqun wajāmiʿātun.
dialogue.en: In the city there are factories, markets and universities.
dialogue.ur: Shehar mein karkhane, bazaar aur jamiaat hain.

dialogue.ar: اِخْتَرْ مَشْروباً: عَصيراً أَوْ حَليباً.
dialogue.tr: ikhtar mashrūban: ʿaṣīran aw ḥalīban.
dialogue.en: Choose a drink: juice or milk.
dialogue.ur: Ek mashroob chuno: juice ya doodh.

dialogue.ar: نَأْكُلُ الغَداءَ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ، ثُمَّ نَذْهَبُ إِلَى السّوقِ.
dialogue.tr: na'kulu l-ghadā'a baʿda ẓ-ẓuhri, thumma nadhhabu ilā s-sūqi.
dialogue.en: We eat lunch after noon, then we go to the market.
dialogue.ur: Hum zohar ke baad khana khate hain, phir bazaar jaate hain.

dialogue.ar: دَخَلْتُ المَدْرَسَةَ فَجَلَسْتُ في الصَّفِّ.
dialogue.tr: dakhaltu l-madrasata fajalastu fī ṣ-ṣaffi.
dialogue.en: I entered the school and sat in the classroom.
dialogue.ur: Main school mein dakhil hua to jamaat mein baith gaya.

dialogue.ar: زَرَعَ المُزارِعُ القَمْحَ وَالشَّعيرَ، وَباعَهُما في الأَسْواقِ.
dialogue.tr: zaraʿa l-muzāriʿu l-qamḥa wash-shaʿīra, wabāʿahumā fī l-'asawqi.
dialogue.en: The farmer planted wheat and barley and sold them in the markets.
dialogue.ur: Kisan ne gandum aur jau boya aur unhein bazaaron mein becha.

q.en: Which letter means "or"?
q.ur: Kaun sa harf "ya" ka matlab deta hai?

q.en: Which letter means "then, after a while"?
q.ur: Kaun sa harf "phir, kuch der baad" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يُفيدُ الجَمْعَ بَعْدَ مُهْلَةٍ؟

q.en: Complete: لَدَيَّ قَلَمٌ، ... كِتابٌ
q.ur: Mukammal karein: لَدَيَّ قَلَمٌ، ... كِتابٌ

q.en: What do these letters do?
q.ur: Yeh harf kya karte hain?

options: Join a word to the one before it

intro.en: Listen to the dialogue about Abdurrahman's family, then say if each sentence is right or wrong. Then compare life in the city and in the village with a partner.
intro.ur: Abdurrahman ke khandaan ka mukaalma suniye aur har jumla sahi ya ghalat batayein. Phir shehar aur gaon ki zindagi ka muqabla karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى الحِوارِ عَنْ أُسْرَةِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثُمَّ قُلْ إِنْ كانَتْ كُلُّ جُمْلَةٍ صَحيحَةً أَمْ خاطِئَةً. بَعْدَ ذلِكَ قارِنْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ بَيْنَ الحَياةِ في المَدينَةِ وَالقَرْيَةِ.

q.en: Which word means "noise"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "shor" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى الصَّوْتِ العالي المُزْعِجِ؟

q.en: Which word means "life"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "zindagi" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى المُدَّةِ الَّتي يَعيشُها الإِنْسانُ؟

q.en: Which word means "countryside"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "dehaat" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى المَكانِ خارِجَ المُدُنِ حَيْثُ المَزارِعُ؟

q.en: Which word means "he bought"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "usne kharida" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني: أَخَذَ شَيْئاً بِالمالِ؟

title.ar: لِماذا يُفَضِّلُ بَعْضُ النّاسِ الحَياةَ في المُدُنِ الكَبيرَة؟
title.en: Why do some people prefer life in big cities?
title.ur: Kuch log bade shehron ki zindagi ko kyun pasand karte hain?

intro.en: A reading text about life in big cities: their problems, why people still prefer them, why villagers migrate, and how city populations are growing.
intro.ur: Bade shehron ki zindagi ke baare mein ek paragraph: unke masail, phir bhi log unhein kyun pasand karte hain, dehati log kyun hijrat karte hain aur aabadi kaise barh rahi hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنِ الحَياةِ في المُدُنِ الكَبيرَةِ: مَشاكِلُها، وَلِماذا يُفَضِّلُها كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ، وَلِماذا يَنْتَقِلُ أَهْلُ القُرى إِلَيْها، وَكَيْفَ يَزيدُ عَدَدُ سُكّانِها.

dialogue.ar: يَعيشُ في المُدُنِ الكُبْرى، مِثْلَ إِسْطَنْبولَ وَالرِّياضِ وَباريسَ، مَلايينُ الأَشْخاصِ.
dialogue.tr: yaʿīshu fī l-muduni l-kubrā, mithla isṭanbūla war-rīḍi wabārīsa, malāayaynu l-'ashkhāṣi.
dialogue.en: Millions of people live in the great cities, such as Istanbul, Riyadh and Paris.
dialogue.ur: Bade shehron mein, jaise Istanbul, Riyadh aur Paris, karoron log rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيُواجِهُ السُّكّانُ هُناكَ صُعوباتٍ كَثيرَةً، كَالضَّوْضاءِ وَغَلاءِ الأَسْعارِ وَطولِ الطَّريقِ إِلَى العَمَلِ.
dialogue.tr: wayūjihu s-sukkānu hunāka ṣuʿūbātin kathīratan, kaḍ-ḍawḍā'i waghalā'i l-'asʿāri waṭūli ṭ-ṭarīqi ilā l-ʿamali.
dialogue.en: The residents there face many difficulties, such as noise, high prices and the long road to work.
dialogue.ur: Wahan ke rehne walon ko bohat si mushkilein hoti hain, jaise shor, mehngai aur kaam tak lamba raasta.

dialogue.ar: وَبِالرُّغْمِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ يُفَضِّلُ كَثيرونَ العَيْشَ فيها؛ فَهُناكَ المُسْتَشْفَياتُ الكَبيرَةُ وَالمَكْتَباتُ وَالأَسْواقُ وَفُرَصُ العَمَلِ.
dialogue.tr: wabilrrughmi min dhālika yufaḍḍilu kathīrūna l-ʿaysha fīhā; fahunāka l-mustashfaytu l-kabīratu wal-maktabātu wal-'asawqu wafuraṣu l-ʿamali.
dialogue.en: Despite that, many prefer to live in them; there are big hospitals, libraries, markets and job opportunities.
dialogue.ur: Iske bawajood bohat se log wahan rehna pasand karte hain; wahan bade hospital, kutub khane, bazaar aur rozgar ke mauqe hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَزْدادُ عَدَدُ سُكّانِ المُدُنِ عاماً بَعْدَ عامٍ، فَكَثيرٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ القُرى يُهاجِرونَ إِلَيْها، وَيَتْرُكونَ الزِّراعَةَ وَالرَّعْيَ.
dialogue.tr: wayazdādu ʿadadu sukkāni l-muduni ʿāman baʿda ʿāmin, fakathīrun min ahli l-qurā yuhājirūna ilayhā, wayatrukūna z-zirāʿata war-raʿya.
dialogue.en: The population of cities increases year after year, as many villagers migrate to them and leave farming and herding.
dialogue.ur: Shehron ki abadi saal ba saal barhti hai kyunke gaon ke bohat se log wahan hijrat karte hain aur kheti baari aur charwahi chhod dete hain.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ أَدْرَكَتْ حُكوماتٌ كَثيرَةٌ خَطَرَ ذَلِكَ، فَبَنَتْ في القُرى مَدارِسَ وَمُسْتَشْفَياتٍ وَطُرُقاً لِيَبْقى أَهْلُها فيها.
dialogue.tr: waqad adrakat ḥukūmātun kathīratun khaṭara dhālika, fabanat fī l-qurā madārisa wamustashfaytin waṭuruqan liyabqā ahluhā fīhā.
dialogue.en: Many governments realised the danger of that, so they built schools, hospitals and roads in the villages so that their people would stay.
dialogue.ur: Bohat si hukoomaton ne is ke khatre ko pehchana aur gaon mein school, hospital aur sadkein banayin taake wahan ke log wahin rahein.

dialogue.ar: في بِدايَةِ القَرْنِ العِشْرينَ كانَتْ نِسْبَةُ سُكّانِ المُدُنِ في العالَمِ صَغيرَةً، ثُمَّ ارْتَفَعَتْ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: fī bidāyati l-qarni l-ʿishrīna kānat nisbatu sukkāni l-muduni fī l-ʿālami ṣaghīratan, thumma rtafaʿat kathīran.
dialogue.en: At the beginning of the twentieth century the share of city dwellers in the world was small, then it rose a lot.
dialogue.ur: Bisween sadi ki ibtida mein duniya mein shehri abadi ka tanasub chhota tha, phir bohat barh gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَاليَوْمَ يَعيشُ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ نِصْفِ سُكّانِ العالَمِ في المُدُنِ، وَعَدَدُ سُكّانِ الأَرْضِ يَزيدُ عَلى ثَمانِيَةِ مِلْيارات.
dialogue.tr: wal-yawma yaʿīshu aktharu min niṣfi sukkāni l-ʿālami fī l-muduni, waʿadadu sukkāni l-'arḍi yazīdu ʿalā thamāniyati milayrāt.
dialogue.en: Today more than half of the world's people live in cities, and the population of the earth exceeds eight billion.
dialogue.ur: Aaj duniya ki aadhi se zyada abadi shehron mein rehti hai aur zameen ki abadi aath arab se zyada hai.

q.en: What difficulties do people in big cities face?
q.ur: Bade shehron ke log kin mushkilon ka saamna karte hain?
q.ar: ما الصُّعوباتُ الَّتي يُواجِهُها سُكّانُ المُدُنِ الكَبيرَةِ؟

options: Noise, high prices and the long road to work
options_ar: الضَّوْضاءُ وَغَلاءُ الأَسْعارِ وَطولُ الطَّريقِ إِلَى العَمَلِ

q.en: Why do many people prefer big cities?
q.ur: Bohat se log bade shehron ko kyun pasand karte hain?
q.ar: لِماذا يُفَضِّلُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ المُدُنَ الكَبيرَةَ؟

options: Hospitals, libraries, markets and jobs are there
options_ar: فيها المُسْتَشْفَياتُ وَالمَكْتَباتُ وَالأَسْواقُ وَفُرَصُ العَمَلِ

q.en: What do villagers leave when they move to the city?
q.ur: Gaon wale shehar jaate hue kya chhodte hain?
q.ar: ماذا يَتْرُكُ أَهْلُ القُرى حينَ يَنْتَقِلونَ إِلَى المَدينَةِ؟

q.en: What share of the world's people live in cities today?
q.ur: Aaj duniya ki kitni abadi shehron mein rehti hai?
q.ar: ما نِسْبَةُ مَنْ يَعيشُ في المُدُنِ مِنْ سُكّانِ العالَمِ اليَوْمَ؟

options: About two and a half percent

intro.en: The object is a noun with the ending -a (manṣūb). It names the thing the doer's action falls on. Example: أَكَلَ الوَلَدُ تُفّاحَةً, the boy ate an apple, and تُفّاحَةً is the object.
intro.ur: Maf'ool bihi woh ism hai jis ke aakhir mein fatha (manṣūb) ho. Yeh us cheez ka naam batata hai jis par kaam karne wale ka kaam waqe hota hai. Misaal: أَكَلَ الوَلَدُ تُفّاحَةً, larke ne seb khaya, aur تُفّاحَةً maf'ool hai.
intro.ar: المَفْعولُ بِهِ اسْمٌ مَنْصوبٌ بِالفَتْحَةِ يَدُلُّ عَلى ما وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ فِعْلُ الفاعِلِ. مِثالٌ: أَكَلَ الوَلَدُ تُفّاحَةً، وَ«تُفّاحَةً» هِيَ المَفْعولُ بِهِ.

dialogue.ar: تَرَكَ الضَّيْفُ الغُرْفَةَ.
dialogue.tr: taraka ḍ-ḍayfu l-ghurfata.
dialogue.en: The guest left the room.
dialogue.ur: Mehmaan ne kamra chhod diya.

dialogue.ar: أَكَلَ الوَلَدُ تُفّاحَةً.
dialogue.tr: akala l-waladu tuffāḥatan.
dialogue.en: The boy ate an apple.
dialogue.ur: Larke ne seb khaya.

dialogue.ar: شَرِبَتِ البِنْتُ الحَليبَ.
dialogue.tr: sharibati l-bintu l-ḥalība.
dialogue.en: The girl drank the milk.
dialogue.ur: Larki ne doodh piya.

dialogue.ar: فَحَصَتِ الطَّبيبَةُ المَريضَ.
dialogue.tr: faḥaṣati ṭ-ṭabībatu l-marīḍa.
dialogue.en: The doctor examined the patient.
dialogue.ur: Doctor ne mareez ka muayna kiya.

dialogue.ar: تَناوَلَ الأَبُ الغَداءَ.
dialogue.tr: tanāwala l-'abu l-ghadā'a.
dialogue.en: The father had lunch.
dialogue.ur: Abbu ne dopahar ka khana khaya.

dialogue.ar: دَرَسَتْ سارَةُ الطِّبَّ في الجامِعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: darasat sāratu ṭ-ṭibba fī l-jāmiʿati.
dialogue.en: Sara studied medicine at the university.
dialogue.ur: Sara ne jamia mein tibb parhi.

q.en: What is the object in «دَرَسَتْ سارَةُ الطِّبَّ»?
q.ur: «دَرَسَتْ سارَةُ الطِّبَّ» mein maf'ool bihi kya hai?
q.ar: ما المَفْعولُ بِهِ في «دَرَسَتْ سارَةُ الطِّبَّ»؟

q.en: What ending does the object have?
q.ur: Maf'ool bihi ke aakhir mein kya harkat hoti hai?
q.ar: ما حَرَكَةُ المَفْعولِ بِهِ في آخِرِهِ؟

q.en: Complete: أَكَلَ الطِّفْلُ ...
q.ur: Mukammal karein: أَكَلَ الطِّفْلُ ...

q.en: What does the object tell us?
q.ur: Maf'ool bihi kya batata hai?

options: Who or what the action fell on
options_ar: مَنْ أَوْ ما وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ الفِعْلُ

intro.en: A student asks a shopkeeper for directions to the central library. Notice the polite phrases and the words for direction: west, left, right.
intro.ur: Ek talib-e-ilm dukandar se markazi library ka raasta poochhta hai. Adab ke alfaaz aur simton ke alfaaz par dhyan dein: maghrib, bayen, dayen.
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ طالِبٌ بائِعاً عَنِ الطَّريقِ إِلَى المَكْتَبَةِ المَرْكَزِيَّةِ. لاحِظِ العِباراتِ المُهَذَّبَةَ وَكَلِماتِ الاتِّجاهِ: غَرْب، يَميناً، يَساراً.

dialogue.ar: لَوْ سَمَحْتَ يا عَمُّ، هَلْ تَعْرِفُ أَيْنَ المَكْتَبَةُ المَرْكَزِيَّةُ؟
dialogue.tr: law samaḥta yā ʿammu, hal taʿrifu ayna l-maktabatu l-markaziyyatu?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, uncle, do you know where the central library is?
dialogue.ur: Chacha, meherbani karke bataiye markazi library kahan hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ يا بُنَيَّ، هِيَ غَرْبَ هَذا السّوقِ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam yā bunayya, hiya gharba hādhā s-sūqi.
dialogue.en: Yes, my son, it is west of this market.
dialogue.ur: Haan beta, woh is bazaar ke maghrib mein hai.

dialogue.ar: وَما أَقْصَرُ طَريقٍ يُوصِلُني إِلَيْها؟
dialogue.tr: wamā aqṣaru ṭarīqin yūṣilunī ilayhā?
dialogue.en: And what is the shortest way that gets me there?
dialogue.ur: Aur mujhe wahan pohanchane wala sab se chhota raasta kaun sa hai?

dialogue.ar: اِتَّجِهْ غَرْباً في هَذا الشّارِعِ حَتّى تَرى إِشارَةً ضَوْئِيَّةً.
dialogue.tr: ittajih gharban fī hādhā sh-shāriʿi ḥattā tarā ishāratan ḍaw'iyyatan.
dialogue.en: Head west in this street until you see a traffic light.
dialogue.ur: Is sadak par maghrib ki taraf chalo jab tak signal na nazar aaye.

dialogue.ar: أَتَّجِهُ غَرْباً حَتّى الإِشارَةِ الضَّوْئِيَّةِ، حَسَناً.
dialogue.tr: attajihu gharban ḥattā l-'ishārati ḍ-ḍaw'iyyati, ḥasanan.
dialogue.en: I head west to the traffic light, all right.
dialogue.ur: Main signal tak maghrib ki taraf jaata hoon, theek hai.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَ الإِشارَةِ اِنْعَطِفْ يَميناً، ثُمَّ اِسْتَمِرَّ حَتّى تَصِلَ إِلى دَوّارٍ كَبيرٍ.
dialogue.tr: ʿinda l-'ishārati inʿaṭif yamīnan, thumma istamirra ḥattā taṣila ilā dawwrin kabīrin.
dialogue.en: At the light turn right, then continue until you reach a big roundabout.
dialogue.ur: Signal par dayen mudo, phir bade chakkar tak seedhe chalte raho.

dialogue.ar: أَنْعَطِفُ يَميناً، ثُمَّ أَسْتَمِرُّ إِلَى الدَّوّارِ.
dialogue.tr: anʿaṭifu yamīnan, thumma astamirru ilā d-dawwri.
dialogue.en: I turn right, then continue to the roundabout.
dialogue.ur: Main dayen mudta hoon, phir chakkar tak chalta hoon.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَ الدَّوّارِ اِتَّجِهْ يَساراً في الشّارِعِ الثّاني.
dialogue.tr: ʿinda d-dawwri ittajih yasāran fī sh-shāriʿi th-thānī.
dialogue.en: At the roundabout head left into the second street.
dialogue.ur: Chakkar par doosri sadak mein bayen taraf jao.

dialogue.ar: أَتَّجِهُ يَساراً في الشّارِعِ الثّاني.
dialogue.tr: attajihu yasāran fī sh-shāriʿi th-thānī.
dialogue.en: I head left into the second street.
dialogue.ur: Main doosri sadak mein bayen jaata hoon.

dialogue.ar: سَتَرى صَيْدَلِيَّةً عِنْدَ الزّاوِيَةِ، وَالمَكْتَبَةُ مُقابِلَها.
dialogue.tr: satarā ṣaydaliyyatan ʿinda z-zāwiyati, wal-maktabatu muqābilahā.
dialogue.en: You will see a pharmacy at the corner, and the library is opposite it.
dialogue.ur: Kone par dawakhana nazar aayega aur library uske saamne hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكَمْ مِتْراً تَبْعُدُ عَنِ الدَّوّارِ؟
dialogue.tr: wakam mitran tabʿudu ʿani d-dawwri?
dialogue.en: And how many metres is it from the roundabout?
dialogue.ur: Aur chakkar se kitne meter door hai?

dialogue.ar: نَحْوَ مِئَةِ مِتْرٍ فَقَطْ.
dialogue.tr: naḥwa mi'ati mitrin faqaṭ.
dialogue.en: About a hundred metres only.
dialogue.ur: Taqreeban sirf sau meter.

dialogue.ar: يَميناً عِنْدَ الإِشارَةِ، ثُمَّ يَساراً عِنْدَ الدَّوّارِ، وَالمَكْتَبَةُ مُقابِلَ الصَّيْدَلِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: yamīnan ʿinda l-'ishārati, thumma yasāran ʿinda d-dawwri, wal-maktabatu muqābila ṣ-ṣaydaliyyati.
dialogue.en: Right at the light, then left at the roundabout, and the library opposite the pharmacy.
dialogue.ur: Signal par dayen, phir chakkar par bayen, aur library dawakhane ke saamne.

dialogue.ar: أَحْسَنْتَ، حَفِظْتَ الطَّريقَ.
dialogue.tr: aḥsanta, ḥafiẓta ṭ-ṭarīqa.
dialogue.en: Well done, you have memorised the way.
dialogue.ur: Shabash, aapne raasta yaad kar liya.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً لَكَ، جَزاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً.
dialogue.tr: shukran laka, jazāka llāh khayran.
dialogue.en: Thank you, may Allah reward you with good.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya, Allah aapko jazaye khair de.

dialogue.ar: عَفْواً يا بُنَيَّ، وَفَّقَكَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: ʿafawan yā bunayya, waffaqaka llāh.
dialogue.en: You are welcome, my son, may Allah grant you success.
dialogue.ur: Koi baat nahi beta, Allah aapko kamyab kare.

vocab.en: may Allah reward you with good

q.en: Where is the central library?
q.ur: Markazi library kahan hai?

q.en: What must he do at the traffic light?
q.ur: Signal par use kya karna hai?

q.en: What will he find at the corner?
q.ur: Corner par use kya milega?

q.en: What does the policeman say after «شُكْراً»?
q.ur: «شُكْراً» ke baad police wala kya kehta hai?

intro.en: A sentence that starts with a noun has two parts: the mubtada' (the thing we talk about) and the khabar (what we say about it). Both end with -u (marfūʿ). Example: القَرْيَةُ جَميلَةٌ, the village is beautiful.
intro.ur: Jo jumla ism se shuru ho uske do hisse hote hain: mubtada (jis ke baare mein baat ho) aur khabar (jo uske baare mein kaha jaye). Dono par damma (marfoo') aata hai. Misaal: القَرْيَةُ جَميلَةٌ, gaon khoobsurat hai.
intro.ar: الجُمْلَةُ الَّتي تَبْدَأُ بِاسْمٍ لَها رُكْنانِ: المُبْتَدَأُ (ما نَتَحَدَّثُ عَنْهُ) وَالخَبَرُ (ما نَقولُهُ عَنْهُ). وَكِلاهُما مَرْفوعٌ. مِثالٌ: القَرْيَةُ جَميلَةٌ.

dialogue.ar: المَدينَةُ مُزْدَحِمَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-madīnatu muzdaḥimatun.
dialogue.en: The city is crowded.
dialogue.ur: Shehar bheed wala hai.

dialogue.ar: أَنا طالِبٌ.
dialogue.tr: anā ṭālibun.
dialogue.en: I am a student.
dialogue.ur: Main talib-e-ilm hoon.

dialogue.ar: المَكْتَبَةُ هادِئَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-maktabatu hādi'atun.
dialogue.en: The library is quiet.
dialogue.ur: Library pur-sukoon hai.

dialogue.ar: الطَّريقانِ طَويلانِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭarīqāni ṭawaylāni.
dialogue.en: The two roads are long.
dialogue.ur: Dono sadkein lambi hain.

dialogue.ar: الضَّوْضاءُ مُشْكِلَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: aḍ-ḍawḍā'u mushkilatun.
dialogue.en: Noise is a problem.
dialogue.ur: Shor ek masla hai.

dialogue.ar: الرِّياضُ عاصِمَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: ar-rīḍu ʿāṣimatun.
dialogue.en: Riyadh is a capital.
dialogue.ur: Riyadh daarul-hukoomat hai.

dialogue.ar: الحَديقَةُ جَميلَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥadīqatu jamīlatun.
dialogue.en: The garden is beautiful.
dialogue.ur: Bagh khoobsurat hai.

dialogue.ar: الأَسْواقُ كَثيرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-'asawqu kathīratun.
dialogue.en: The markets are many.
dialogue.ur: Bazaar bohat hain.

q.en: In «المَكْتَبَةُ هادِئَةٌ», what is the mubtada'?
q.ur: «المَكْتَبَةُ هادِئَةٌ» mein mubtada kya hai?

q.en: What is the khabar in «هَذا طَبيبٌ»?
q.ur: «هَذا طَبيبٌ» mein khabar kaun sa hai?

q.en: What ending do the mubtada' and khabar usually have?
q.ur: Mubtada aur khabar ke aakhir mein aam taur par kya harkat hoti hai?
q.ar: ما الحَرَكَةُ المُعْتادَةُ في آخِرِ المُبْتَدَأِ وَالخَبَرِ؟

q.en: Where does the mubtada' usually come?
q.ur: Mubtada aam taur par kahan aata hai?

options: At the start of the sentence

intro.en: Listen to a text about a family's visit to the city, then describe with a partner how Badr gets to the hospital, and discuss why people move between village and city.
intro.ur: Shehar mein ek khandaan ke daure ka text suniye, phir saathi ke saath batayein ke Badr hospital kaise pahunchega aur log gaon aur shehar ke darmiyan kyun jaate hain.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى نَصٍّ عَنْ زِيارَةِ أُسْرَةٍ لِلْمَدينَةِ، ثُمَّ صِفْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ كَيْفَ يَصِلُ بَدْرٌ إِلى المُسْتَشْفى، وَناقِشا لِماذا يَنْتَقِلُ النّاسُ بَيْنَ القَرْيَةِ وَالمَدينَةِ.

q.en: What does «شَمال» mean?
q.ur: «شَمال» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which of these is a place name?
q.ur: In mein se kaun si jagah hai?

q.en: Which is a problem of big cities?
q.ur: Bade shehron ka ek masla kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى مُشْكِلَةٍ في المُدُنِ الكَبيرَةِ؟

q.en: What does «حَديقَة» mean?
q.ur: «حَديقَة» ka matlab kya hai?

title.ur: Dunya ke bade shehron mein se

intro.en: A reading text about three big cities: Tokyo, Cairo and New York. It tells where each is, how many people live there, and what it is known for.
intro.ur: Teen bade shehron ke baare mein paragraph: Tokyo, Qahira aur New York. Kahan hain, kitni aabadi hai aur kis cheez ke liye mashhoor hain.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنْ ثَلاثِ مُدُنٍ كَبيرَةٍ: طوكيو وَالقاهِرَةِ وَنيويورك. يَذْكُرُ أَيْنَ تَقَعُ كُلٌّ مِنْها، وَكَمْ عَدَدُ سُكّانِها، وَبِماذا تُعْرَفُ.

dialogue.ar: طوكيو عاصِمَةُ اليابانِ، وَهِيَ مِنْ أَكْبَرِ مُدُنِ العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: ṭūkīaw ʿāṣimatu l-aybāni, wahiya min akbari muduni l-ʿālami.
dialogue.en: Tokyo is the capital of Japan and one of the biggest cities in the world.
dialogue.ur: Tokyo Japan ka daarul-hukoomat hai aur duniya ke sab se bade shehron mein se hai.

dialogue.ar: يَسْكُنُ الإِمْبِراطورُ في قَصْرِها الكَبيرِ، وَتَجْتَمِعُ الحُكومَةُ هُناكَ، وَتَنْتَشِرُ المَصارِفُ وَالعِماراتُ العالِيَةُ في شَوارِعِها.
dialogue.tr: yaskunu l-'imbirāṭūru fī qaṣrihā l-kabīri, watajtamiʿu l-ḥukūmatu hunāka, watantashiru l-maṣārifu wal-ʿimārātu l-ʿāliyatu fī shawriʿihā.
dialogue.en: The emperor lives in its big palace, the government meets there, and banks and tall buildings are spread along its streets.
dialogue.ur: Shahenshah wahan ke bade mahal mein rehta hai, hukoomat wahan jama hoti hai aur uski sadkon par bank aur oonchi imaratein phaili hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَخافُ سُكّانُها مِنَ الزَّلازِلِ، وَيَشْكونَ مِنَ الازْدِحامِ.
dialogue.tr: wayakhāfu sukkānuhā mina z-zalāzili, wayashkūna mina l-zdiḥāmi.
dialogue.en: Its residents fear earthquakes and complain about crowding.
dialogue.ur: Wahan ke log zalzalon se darte hain aur bheed ki shikayat karte hain.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا القاهِرَةُ فَهِيَ عاصِمَةُ مِصْرَ، وَيَمُرُّ بِها نَهْرُ النّيلِ.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-qāhiratu fahiya ʿāṣimatu miṣra, wayamurru bihā nahru n-nīli.
dialogue.en: As for Cairo, it is the capital of Egypt, and the River Nile passes through it.
dialogue.ur: Rahi Qahira, woh Misr ka daarul-hukoomat hai aur uske beech se Dariya-e-Neel guzarta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيُسَمّيها كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ مَدينَةَ المَآذِنِ لِكَثْرَةِ مَساجِدِها القَديمَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wayusammīhā kathīrun mina n-nāsi madīnata l-ma'ādhini likathrati masājidihā l-qadīmati.
dialogue.en: Many people call it the city of minarets because of its many old mosques.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se log use minaron ka shehar kehte hain kyunke wahan purani masjidein bohat hain.

dialogue.ar: وَفيها جامِعُ الأَزْهَرِ الَّذي أَصْبَحَ جامِعَةً يَأْتي إِلَيْها طُلّابٌ مِنْ بِلادٍ كَثيرَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wafīhā jāmiʿu l-'azhari lladhī aṣbaḥa jāmiʿatan ya'tī ilayhā ṭullābun min bilādin kathīratin.
dialogue.en: In it is al-Azhar mosque, which became a university to which students come from many countries.
dialogue.ur: Wahan Jaame Azhar hai jo ab jamia ban gayi hai aur bohat se mulkon ke talba wahan aate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَنيويورْكُ مَدينَةٌ ضَخْمَةٌ في أَمْريكا، وَفيها مَقَرُّ الأُمَمِ المُتَّحِدَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wanīawayawrku madīnatun ḍakhmatun fī amrīkā, wafīhā maqarru l-'umami l-muttaḥidati.
dialogue.en: New York is a huge city in America, and in it is the seat of the United Nations.
dialogue.ur: New York America ka ek bohat bada shehar hai aur wahan Iqwam-e-Muttahida ka markaz hai.

dialogue.ar: هاجَرَ إِلَيْها أُناسٌ مِنْ كُلِّ بِلادِ العالَمِ، وَيَبْلُغُ عَدَدُ سُكّانِها مَلايينَ.
dialogue.tr: hājara ilayhā unāsun min kulli bilādi l-ʿālami, wayablughu ʿadadu sukkānihā malāayayna.
dialogue.en: People from all the countries of the world migrated to it, and its population reaches millions.
dialogue.ur: Duniya bhar ke mulkon se log wahan hijrat kar ke aaye aur uski abadi karoron tak pohanchti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَكْثُرُ فيها ناطِحاتُ السَّحابِ، وَمِنْ مُشْكِلاتِها الفَقْرُ وَالمُخَدِّراتُ.
dialogue.tr: watakthuru fīhā nāṭiḥātu s-saḥābi, wamin mushkilātihā l-faqru wal-mukhaddirātu.
dialogue.en: Skyscrapers are many in it, and among its problems are poverty and drugs.
dialogue.ur: Wahan aasman choone wali imaratein bohat hain aur uske masle ghurbat aur nasha hain.

q.en: What is Tokyo?
q.ur: Tokyo kya hai?

q.en: On which river is Cairo?
q.ur: Qahira kis darya par hai?

q.en: What is New York known for in the text?
q.ur: Text mein New York kis cheez ke liye mashhoor hai?

q.en: Why is Cairo called the city of minarets?
q.ur: Qahira ko minaron ka shehar kyun kehte hain?

options: Because of its many old mosques

intro.en: A verb has three kinds. The past (māḍī) tells what happened before now. The present (muḍāriʿ) tells what happens now or later. The command (amr) asks for something to be done. Example: كَتَبَ (he wrote), يَكْتُبُ (he writes), اُكْتُبْ (write!).
intro.ur: Fe'l ki teen qismein hain. Maazi: jo pehle ho chuka. Muzare': jo abhi ya baad mein ho. Amr: kuch karne ka hukm. Misaal: كَتَبَ (usne likha), يَكْتُبُ (wo likhta hai), اُكْتُبْ (likho).
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ ثَلاثَةُ أَنْواعٍ: الماضي لِما حَدَثَ قَبْلَ الآنِ، وَالمُضارِعُ لِما يَحْدُثُ الآنَ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ، وَالأَمْرُ لِطَلَبِ فِعْلِ شَيْءٍ. مِثالٌ: كَتَبَ، يَكْتُبُ، اُكْتُبْ.

q.en: Which kind of verb is «رَجَعَ»?
q.ur: «رَجَعَ» kis qism ka fe'l hai?

q.en: Which kind of verb is «يَشْرَبُ»?
q.ur: «يَشْرَبُ» kis qism ka fe'l hai?

q.en: Which kind of verb is «اِشْرَبْ»?
q.ur: «اِشْرَبْ» kis qism ka fe'l hai?

q.en: What is the command of «سافَرَ»?
q.ur: «سافَرَ» ka amr kya hai?

intro.en: Practise what you learned: spot the past, present and command forms, and put sentences in order. Study the pages and try the exercises by yourself.
intro.ur: Jo seekha hai uski mashq karein: maazi, muzare' aur amr pehchaniye aur jumlon ko tarteeb dein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى ما تَعَلَّمْتَ: مَيِّزِ الماضيَ وَالمُضارِعَ وَالأَمْرَ، وَرَتِّبِ الجُمَلَ. اُدْرُسِ الصَّفَحاتِ وَجَرِّبِ التَّمارينَ بِنَفْسِكَ.

q.en: What do we call a verb that asks for something to be done?
q.ur: Jo fe'l kuch karne ka hukm de use kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا نُسَمّي الفِعْلَ الَّذي يَطْلُبُ فِعْلَ شَيْءٍ؟

q.en: Which is a past verb?
q.ur: Kaun sa fe'l maazi hai?

q.en: Which is a present verb?
q.ur: Kaun sa fe'l muzare' hai?

q.en: Which is a command?
q.ur: Kaun sa amr hai?

title.ur: Likhne ki mashq, khat aur imla

intro.en: Write about a picture of a busy road, write on the topic Life in the City, and learn the spelling rule: most words are written as they sound, with a few exceptions.
intro.ur: Bheed wali sadak ki tasveer par likhein, "zindagi shehar mein" par mazmoon likhein aur imla ka qaida seekhein: aksar alfaaz jaise bole jaate hain waise likhe jaate hain, chand ke ilawa.
intro.ar: اُكْتُبْ عَنْ صورَةٍ لِطَريقٍ مُزْدَحِمٍ، وَاكْتُبْ في مَوْضوعِ «الحَياةُ في المَدينَةِ»، وَتَعَلَّمْ قاعِدَةَ الإِمْلاءِ: أَكْثَرُ الكَلِماتِ تُكْتَبُ كَما تُنْطَقُ، وَلَها اسْتِثْناءاتٌ قَليلَةٌ.

dialogue.ar: ذَهَبَ عَمْرٌو إِلَى المَكْتَبَةِ.
dialogue.tr: dhahaba ʿamrunaw ilā l-maktabati.
dialogue.en: Amr went to the library.
dialogue.ur: Amr library gaya.

dialogue.ar: الطّالِبُ وَالطّالِبَةُ ذَهَبا إِلَى الدَّرْسِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭālibu waṭ-ṭālibatu dhahabā ilā d-darsi.
dialogue.en: The male student and the female student went to the lesson.
dialogue.ur: Talib aur talibah sabaq mein gaye.

dialogue.ar: هَؤُلاءِ الأَوْلادُ لَعِبوا في الحَديقَةِ.
dialogue.tr: hā'ulā'i l-'awlādu laʿibū fī l-ḥadīqati.
dialogue.en: These boys played in the garden.
dialogue.ur: Yeh larke bagh mein khele.

dialogue.ar: ما اسْمُ مَدينَتِكَ؟ اِسْمُها حَلَبُ.
dialogue.tr: mā smu madīnatika? ismuhā ḥalabu.
dialogue.en: What is the name of your city? Its name is Aleppo.
dialogue.ur: Aapke shehar ka naam kya hai? Uska naam Halab hai.

q.en: What is the title of the topic to write?
q.ur: Mazmoon ka unwan kya hai?

q.en: Which handwriting style does the book ask for?
q.ur: Kitab kis khat mein likhne ko kehti hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ نَوْعٍ مِنَ الخَطِّ يَطْلُبُهُ الكِتابُ؟

q.en: Which letter is written but not pronounced in «عَمْرو»?
q.ur: «عَمْرو» mein kaun sa harf likha jata hai lekin bola nahin jata?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يُكْتَبُ وَلا يُنْطَقُ في «عَمْرو»؟

q.en: In «الطّالِب», what is written but not pronounced?
q.ur: «الطّالِب» mein kya likha jata hai magar bola nahi jata?
q.ar: في «الطّالِب» ما الَّذي يُكْتَبُ وَلا يُنْطَقُ؟

intro.en: A review of earlier units: read a short text, then practise plurals, prepositions and punctuation marks. In the reading, a husband describes his wife's working day.
intro.ur: Pichli ikaiyon ki dohrai: ek chhota paragraph parhein, phir jama, huroof-e-jar aur alamat-e-tarqeem ki mashq karein.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِوَحَداتٍ سابِقَةٍ: اِقْرَأْ نَصّاً قَصيراً، ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الجُموعِ وَحُروفِ الجَرِّ وَعَلاماتِ التَّرْقيمِ. في النَّصِّ يَصِفُ زَوْجٌ يَوْمَ عَمَلِ زَوْجَتِهِ.
